name: Kylie Cantrall
bio: Kylie Lorena Cantrall (born June 25, 2005) is an American actress, singer and dancer. Known for her role as Gabby Duran in the Disney Channel TV series Gabby Duran and the Unsittables (2019-2021). She starred as Red in the Disney's Descendants franchise.
